notes.title: Consumables: Latest Demo Update and Feedback Collection
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! The demo of Consumables has been updated.
The content now includes the only passable ending of the first level and two non-passable endings.
We welcome your feedback! Please feel free to comment directly on this post—I value your opinions greatly.

Note:

The final full version of the first level will differ from this version, featuring more puzzles, non-passable endings, and item usage effects.
This demo is available for a limited time and will be taken down some time after the 2025 February New Products Festival.
